description: This file defines the EdgeDownlinkTableConfig class, which extends EntityTableConfig to configure and manage a table displaying edge event data, including fetching data, updating columns, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: EdgeDownlinkTableConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for displaying and managing a table of edge events, including data fetching, column setup, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Fetches edge events and updates internal state based on entity attributes.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Processes fetched attributes to update the queueStartTs timestamp.

methods.name: updateColumns
methods.description: Configures the columns of the table, including event time, type, action, entity ID, status, and data view.

methods.name: updateEdgeEventStatus
methods.description: Determines the display status ('deployed' or 'pending') based on createdTime and queueStartTs.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if an event's createdTime indicates it is pending based on queueStartTs.

methods.name: isEdgeEventHasData
methods.description: Checks if an edge event has associated data, excluding admin settings or delete actions.

methods.name: prepareEdgeEventContent
methods.description: Retrieves and serializes edge event content for display.

methods.name: showEdgeEventContent
methods.description: Displays edge event content in a dialog window.

methods.name: showEntityNotFoundError
methods.description: Dispatches an error notification if entity content cannot be loaded.
